title: Targeting the dopaminergic midbrain with precision 7-Tesla biofeedback training in depression: A proof-of-principle randomized controlled trial
title_zh: 精准7特斯拉生物反馈训练靶向多巴胺中脑在抑郁症中的应用：一项证明性随机对照试验
abstract: Abstract The significant heterogeneity of major depressive disorder (MDD) requires the development of interventions that directly target underlying cognitive or neurobiological mechanisms. This work tested the efficacy of self-modulation of the dopaminergic midbrain with high-field 7-Tesla functional MRI biofeedback in a randomized, controlled, proof-of-principle trial that targeted motivation regulation. A total of N = 62 unmedicated participants (MDD and healthy controls) were randomized to receive either Active or Sham 7-Tesla functional MRI biofeedback and completed clinical assessments pre- and up to 30-days post-training. Factor analysis of clinical symptom change revealed a single latent clinical improvement factor that was significantly improved in the Active MDD compared to the Sham MDD group, immediately post-training (β = 15.85, t = 2.31, p = 0.03), and at 24-hours post-training (β = 22.84, t = 2.45, p = 0.02); effects were diminished and no longer significant at 7-day and 30-day follow-ups. Results of specific phenotypic clinical analysis revealed that depressed mood (F = 5.04, p = 0.029) and negative affect (F = 5.21, p = 0.027), but not positive affect, were most improved by the Active biofeedback intervention. Active biofeedback training engaged functional coupling over time between the VTA and the lateral frontal cortex in the MDD group (F = 6.03, p = 0.017), and greater overall VTA regulation was associated with clinical improvement (R = 0.268, p = 0.048). Together, these results indicate the potential utility of dopaminergic midbrain-based biofeedback training for improvement of mood and negative affect in MDD.
abstract_zh: 摘要 主要抑郁障碍（MDD）的显著异质性需要开发直接针对潜在认知或神经生物机制的干预措施。本研究测试了在随机、对照、证明性试验中使用高场7特斯拉功能磁共振成像（fMRI）生物反馈进行自我调节多巴胺中脑的有效性，目标是调节动机。共有N=62名未服药参与者（MDD和健康对照）被随机分配接受主动或安慰剂7特斯拉fMRI生物反馈，并完成了训练前及训练后30天的临床评估。临床症状变化的因子分析揭示了一个单一的潜在临床改善因子，在主动MDD组与安慰剂MDD组相比，在训练后立即（β=15.85，t=2.31，p=0.03）以及训练后24小时（β=22.84，t=2.45，p=0.02）显著改善；在7天和30天随访时效应减弱且不再显著。具体表型临床分析结果显示，抑郁情绪（F=5.04，p=0.029）和负性情感（F=5.21，p=0.027）在主动生物反馈干预下得到最显著改善，而正性情感则未见显著变化。主动生物反馈训练在MDD组中随着时间的推移促进了VTA与侧前额叶皮层之间的功能耦合（F=6.03，p=0.017），且整体VTA调节程度与临床改善相关（R=0.268，p=0.048）。综上所述，这些结果表明基于多巴胺中脑的生物反馈训练在改善MDD的情绪和负性情感方面具有潜在实用价值。
